operations.name: GetPaneConfigurations
operations.description: List all currently defined panes of a device for a specified video output (regardless if this pane is visible at a moment). A Pane is a display area on the monitor that is attached to a video output. A pane has a PaneConfiguration that describes which entities are associated with the pane. A client has to configure the pane according to the connection to be established by setting the AudioOutput and/or AudioSourceToken. If a Token is not set, the corresponding session will not be established.
